# Benchmarks

## Methodology

- Baselines: PyPDF2, pdfplumber, PyMuPDF (fitz)
- Corpus: fixed, versioned set in `benchmarks/corpus/` (see list below)
- Each document parsed N=10 times per library; median and p95 wall-clock time reported
- Tier 1 (digital-native) and Tier 2 (scanned/OCR) results are **never averaged together** — they measure fundamentally different workloads
- Hardware/environment used for the run is logged at generation time

---

## Corpus

| ID | Description | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| doc-01 | Single-column digital-native report | 1 |

| doc-03 | Dense legal/contract document | 1 |
| doc-04 | Scanned form (image-only) | 2 |
| doc-05 | Mixed (digital + scanned pages) | mixed |
